content: This information is not a substitute for the advice of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete details about this product and your specific health needs. Before taking isoniazid, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Consuming alcohol may increase the risk of liver disease. Additionally, this medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine. Liquid forms of this medication may contain sugar, so caution is advised if you have diabetes or conditions requiring sugar restriction. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. While it passes into breast milk, it is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests, such as urine glucose tests, potentially causing false results. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms like unconsciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While taking this medication, lab and medical tests (e.g., sputum tests, kidney/liver function tests, complete blood counts) should be conducted. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose. If you are on a weekly dosing schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If you remember the missed dose the next day or later, consult your doctor or pharmacist for a new dosing schedule. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For further guidance, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not individualized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
